lines.en: My long beak splits the wind like a blade
I glide over this open plain
Wings spread, the grassland below me
Skimming low, the grass ripples with me
I move slowly, but I see far
My shadow hops along the ground
When the wind holds, I save my strength
The riverbank is today's route
I fold my wings, land, and take a few steps
My long beak sweeps down over the water
A fish glints in the shallows
I climb a little and round the trees

lines.zh: 这身骨架很轻，风一推就动
lines.en: My frame is light, the wind pushes me along
My tail steadies the line of flight

lines.zh: 我看清每一片水面的波纹
lines.en: I read every ripple on the water
The grass is too tall, so I fly over it
My wing membrane looks almost clear in the light
The next stop is the next shoal
I perch by the bank and watch the water
Wings half open, ready to leave
The wind shifted, and I turned to match
This river is shallower than I remember
I lift my long beak and sniff
Fish under the water are out of sight
I wait for the ripples to show themselves
Perfectly still, like a dead branch
Good sun, so I dry my wing membrane
The plain is vast, so I rest first

lines.zh: 有影子投下来，我不喜欢
lines.en: A shadow falls, and I do not like it
I give a soft call
Nothing in the grass is worth eating

lines.zh: 我盯着水面上那圈涟漪
lines.en: I fix on that ring spreading on the water
You stand upright, so I look at you
My beak points at you, but I stay still
Do you have a fish in that hand
I will not strike first, so you decide
There are only two of us on this plain
I tilt my head toward you
Throw a stone and I leave

lines.zh: 站远点，我怕你踩我的翼
lines.en: Stand back, I fear for my wings

lines.zh: 你这个子，比我见过的都高
lines.en: You are taller than anything I have met

lines.zh: 我盯了你一会儿，没兴趣
lines.en: I watched you a while, and lost interest
My wing was struck
These light bones cannot take that
I cry out, sharp and short
I hop off to the side
Blood beads on my feathers
I tilt and nearly tip over
My wing membrane aches and tightens
You hit my body
I brace my wings and steady myself
This pain will fade once I fly
The smell of fish comes from your side
My long beak is already set
Hand it over, I will not ask twice
One fish keeps me flying a day
Lift the fish and I will follow
I am not snatching, I am waiting

lines.zh: 这水里的小东西我抓腻了
lines.en: I am tired of catching things in water
Fish are clearest when seen from above

lines.zh: 我压低身子，靠近你的手
lines.en: I crouch and edge toward your hand

lines.zh: 鱼落地的声音我听得见
lines.en: I can hear a fish hit the ground
You brushed my wing
I pull away, folding my wings fast

lines.zh: 骨头这么轻，撞一下就晃
lines.en: These bones are so light, one bump rocks me
I sidestep, and it feels wrong
You are far harder than the wind
I stagger, then steady myself
My beak tip nearly touched you

lines.zh: 这样贴着，我起飞会伤到你
lines.en: This close, my takeoff could hurt you
I shake out my wings
Next time I will go over you
Two long beaks meet at the riverbank

lines.zh: 我张开翼，量了量对方的翼展
lines.en: Wings open, I measure my rival's span
My kind's call is sharp and thin

lines.zh: 平原够大，可以一起绕圈
lines.en: The plain is wide enough to circle together
We step through the same shallows

lines.zh: 配对之后，猎物要分双份
lines.en: Paired up, the catch must be split in two
I raise my beak upward as an answer

lines.zh: 翼膜碰翼膜，就是同意了
lines.en: Membrane to membrane, and it is agreed

lines.zh: 同飞一段，就知道合不合适
lines.en: Flying together shows if we fit

lines.zh: 今天的风，适合两只一起
lines.en: Today's wind suits the two of us

lines.zh: 喙夹住这点东西很费劲
lines.en: My beak struggles to pinch this
I pick it up, and drop it again
This would not fill my long jaws
I bend my long neck down to reach
Too heavy, my wings cannot lift it

lines.zh: 捡起来先看看是不是鱼
lines.en: Picked up — first check whether it is fish
Toss it up, then catch it in one bite.
Not edible, so I drop it
I nudge it to the water's edge
My claws are weak, my beak must do it
A stir underwater, and I am locked on
My long beak aims at that silver flash
The wind carries me above it
From this height, nothing escapes
I lower my body and pull my wings in
That one, the closest to the shallows
I have read the fish's path
Small target, but I am precise
My beak is already open
No circling this time
I track it from above as it swims
It dives deeper, so I descend
My wing shadow falls on the water
I count the next time it surfaces
My beak is a breath above the water
It turns, and so do I
Patience matters more than speed
Ripples begin to spread
No rush, the current will help me
I dive only at the final moment
My long beak stabs into the water
My needle teeth clamp shut
I sweep across the surface
Fast and light, that strike
The splash rises higher than I do
I rake my beak tip back
One wingbeat and I rise

lines.zh: 这口不够大，但也算一顿
lines.en: A small mouthful, but still a meal
I shake the water off my beak
Catch it, then climb
I glide down from above
My wing shadow lands on the grass first
The plain's wind is just right
Beak forward, I settle by the river
The fish here have not learned to hide

lines.zh: 我先绕着这片水转一圈
lines.en: I circle this water once
My wing membrane shines in the light

lines.zh: 骨头很轻，落地几乎没声
lines.en: My light bones land almost silently
I look up at this sky
A shadow appears above the riverbank
I fold my wings and stand
Shallows here, very good
Flame catches my wing membrane and I shriek
Light bones make a fall hurt more
Water floods my long beak and I thrash
I fly low over water and spear fish.
An arrow grazes my beak
Magic seizes hold of my wings
Too long without food and I cannot fly
Lightning runs through me and scorches my wings

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我无处滑翔
lines.en: In the void there is no wind to glide on
